1.word_for_word: सप्तमे भगवल्-लीलावतारा ब्रह्मणोदिताः । — In the seventh, the incarnations of the Lord’s pastimes are revealed by Lord Brahmā.; नारदाय तु तत्-कर्म प्रयोजन-गुणैः सह ॥ — For Nārada, however, that action, along with its purpose and qualities, was described.; यत्र यदा क्षिति-तलोद्धरणार्थं वाराहीं तनुं बिभ्रत् सन्नुद्यतोऽनन्तस् तदा तं सुप्रसिद्धं हिरण्याक्षं दंष्ट्रया ददार ॥ — When the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Ananta, assumed the form of Vārāhī to lift the earth from the earth, He pierced the well-known deer’s eyes with His fangs.; यस्य वराहस्य रूपं बिभ्रद् ईश्वर इमां पृथिवीं गुहां गूढ-स्थाने सलिलस्य मध्ये प्रविष्टाम् अविन्दल् लब्धवान् इति श्रुतेर् अर्थः ॥१-२॥ — The meaning of the Vedas is that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, assuming the form of a boar, found this earth in a cave in a hidden place in the midst of water.
1.translation: In the seventh, the incarnations of the Lord’s pastimes are revealed by Lord Brahmā. For Nārada, however, that action, along with its purpose and qualities, was described. When the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Ananta, assumed the form of Vārāhī to lift the earth from the earth, He pierced the well-known deer’s eyes with His fangs. The meaning of the Vedas is that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, assuming the form of a boar, found this earth in a cave in a hidden place in the midst of water.

2.word_for_word: यज्ञावतारम् आह । — He said the sacrificial incarnation.; रुचेः प्रजापतेः सकाशात् तद्-भार्याया आकूतेः सूनुः सुतः सुयज्ञो नाम जातः । — Ruci, the creator, had a son named Suyajna, who was born to his wife, Ākūti.; स च स्व-भार्यायां दक्षिणायां सुयमान् देवान् अजनयत् । — He gave birth to Suyamān, the son of Deva, by his wife Dakṣiṇā.; स एवेन्द्रः सन् यदा आर्तिम् अहरत् तदा पूर्वं सुयज्ञ इत्य् उक्तोऽप्य् अनु पश्चान् मनुना मातामहेन हरिर् इत्य् उक्तः । — When he, being the same Indra, took away the suffering, he was first called Suyajna, but later Manu, his grandfather, called him Hari.; अनेन देवोत्पादनं लोक-त्रयार्तिहरणं च तस्य कर्म दर्शितम् ॥२॥ — This has shown His action in producing the gods and in removing the sufferings of the three worlds.
2.translation: He said the sacrificial incarnation. Ruci, the creator, had a son named Suyajna, who was born to his wife, Ākūti. He gave birth to Suyamān, the son of Deva, by his wife Dakṣiṇā. When he, being the same Indra, took away the suffering, he was first called Suyajna, but later Manu, his grandfather, called him Hari. This has shown His action in producing the gods and in removing the sufferings of the three worlds.

3.word_for_word: कपिलावतारम् आह । — He said to the Kapila incarnation.; कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेर् गृहे च तद्-भार्यायां देवहूत्यां जज्ञे । — He was born in the house of Kardama, the creator of the universe, by his wife, Devahūti.; नवभिः स्त्रीभिर् भगिनीभिः सह । — with nine female sisters.; स च स्व-मात्रे आत्म-गतिं ब्रह्म-विद्याम् उक्तवान् । — He also spoke of the self-movement in his own mother as the knowledge of the Absolute Truth.; यया आत्म-गत्या सा आत्मनः शमलं मलिनी-करणं गुण-सङ्ग-रूपं पङ्कम् अस्मिन्न् एव जन्मनि विधूय कपिलस्य गतिं मुक्तिं प्राप्तवती ॥३॥ — By that self-movement she in this very life washed away the impurities of herself, the mud in the form of attachment to the modes of nature, and attained the path of Kapila and liberation.
3.translation: He said to the Kapila incarnation. He was born in the house of Kardama, the creator of the universe, by his wife, Devahūti. with nine female sisters. He also spoke of the self-movement in his own mother as the knowledge of the Absolute Truth. By that self-movement she in this very life washed away the impurities of herself, the mud in the form of attachment to the modes of nature, and attained the path of Kapila and liberation.

4.word_for_word: दत्तात्रेयावतारम् आह । — He said the incarnation of Dattatreya.; मयाहम् एव तुभ्यं दत्त इति यद् यत आह ततः स नाम्ना दत्तो जातः । — When he said, “I have given it to you,” he was given it by name.; स्व-भक्तेभ्यो योगैश्वर्य-दानं तच्-चरितं च दर्शयति । — He shows His devotees the gift of the power of yoga and His character.; यस्य पाद-पङ्कजयोः परागस् तेन पवित्रा देहा येषां ते । — Those whose bodies are purified by the pollen of the lotus feet of the Lord; उभयीम् ऐहिकीम् आमुष्मिकीं च भुक्ति-मुक्ति-रूपां वा ॥४॥ — Both worldly and transcendental, or in the form of enjoyment and liberation.
4.translation: He said the incarnation of Dattatreya. When he said, “I have given it to you,” he was given it by name. He shows His devotees the gift of the power of yoga and His character. Those whose bodies are purified by the pollen of the lotus feet of the Lord Both worldly and transcendental, or in the form of enjoyment and liberation.

5.word_for_word: कुमारावतारम् आह । — He said the Kumara Avatar.; मे मया आदौ यत् तपस् तप्तं तस्मात् स्व-तपसो मत्-तपसो हेतोः स हरिश् चतुःसनोऽभूत् । — Because of the austerities I had performed in the beginning, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, became four-seated.; सनत्कुमारः सनकः सनन्दनः सनातन इति चत्वारः सन-शब्दा नाम्नि यस्य सः । — Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sanandana and Sanatana are the four words in his name.; कथम्भूतात् स्व-तपसः ? — How about self-penance?; सनाद् अखण्डितात् । — from the eternal and unbroken.; यद् वा, स्व-तपसः सनाद् दानात् समर्पणाद् इत्य् अर्थः । — That is, by the practice of one’s own austerities, charity and devotion.; षणु दाने । — Shanu Dane.; स च पूर्व-कल्पस्य सम्प्लवे प्रलये विनष्टम् उच्छिन्न-सम्प्रदायम् आत्म-तत्त्वम् इह अस्मिन् कल्पे सम्यग् जगाद उक्तवान् । — He also spoke perfectly here in this age of the Self, which had been destroyed in the flood of the previous age, and which had been cut off from the sect.; सम्यक्त्वं दर्शयति—यद् गदित-मात्रम् एव मुनय आत्मनात्मनि मनस्य् अचक्षत साक्षाद् अपश्यन् ॥५॥ — It shows perfection—that which the sages saw in their own minds in their own minds, seeing it directly, as soon as it was spoken.
5.translation: He said the Kumara Avatar. Because of the austerities I had performed in the beginning, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, became four-seated. Sanatkumara, Sanaka, Sanandana and Sanatana are the four words in his name. How about self-penance? from the eternal and unbroken. That is, by the practice of one’s own austerities, charity and devotion. Shanu Dane. He also spoke perfectly here in this age of the Self, which had been destroyed in the flood of the previous age, and which had been cut off from the sect. It shows perfection—that which the sages saw in their own minds in their own minds, seeing it directly, as soon as it was spoken.

6.word_for_word: नर-नारायणावतारम् आह—धर्मस्य पत्न्यां दक्ष-दुहितरि मूर्ति-संज्ञायां नारायणो नर इति मूर्ति-द्वयेन जातः । — He describes the incarnation of Nara and Nārāyaṇa as follows: Nārāyaṇa was born of two idols, namely Nara and Nara, in the name of Murti, the daughter of Dakṣa, the wife of Dharma.; कथम्भूतः ? — How did it happen?; स्वोऽसाधारणस् तपः-प्रभावो यस्य। — who has his own extraordinary austerities.; तद् एवाह—अनङ्गस्य पृतनाः देव्योऽप्सरसो भगवतः सकाशाद् आत्मनः स्व-प्रतिरूपा उर्वश्य्-आद्याः स्त्रीर् दृष्ट्वा तस्य नियमावलोपं व्रत-भङ्गं घटितुं साधयितुं न शेकुः । — That is what he said—the goddesses and Apsaras, who were the soldiers of Anaṅga, saw women like Urvaśī, who were their own counterparts, coming from the presence of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; यद् वा, आत्मनः स्वस्य यो नियमस् तपो-नाशन-रूपस् तस्य अवलोपं तत्र दृष्ट्वा भगवतस् तं घटयितुं न शेकुर् इति । — In other words, seeing there the abolition of the law of the self, which is the form of the destruction of austerities, the Lord could not reduce it.; एतच् चाख्यानम् एकादशे भविष्यति ॥६॥ — This story will be told in the eleventh.
6.translation: He describes the incarnation of Nara and Nārāyaṇa as follows: Nārāyaṇa was born of two idols, namely Nara and Nara, in the name of Murti, the daughter of Dakṣa, the wife of Dharma. How did it happen? who has his own extraordinary austerities. That is what he said—the goddesses and Apsaras, who were the soldiers of Anaṅga, saw women like Urvaśī, who were their own counterparts, coming from the presence of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. In other words, seeing there the abolition of the law of the self, which is the form of the destruction of austerities, the Lord could not reduce it. This story will be told in the eleventh.

7.word_for_word: यत्र काम-विजयी क्रोधोऽपि बिभेति यत्र कामो न प्रभवतीति किं वक्तव्यम् इत्य् आह—कामम् इति । — Where even anger, which conquers lust, is afraid, where lust does not prevail, what is to be said?; कृतिनः श्री-रुद्र-प्रमुखा रोष-युक्तया दृष्ट्या कामं दहन्ति । — The creators, headed by Sri and Rudra, burn lust with their angry gaze.; रोषं त्व् आत्मानं दहन्तम् अपि ते न दहन्ति, क्रोधेन अभिभूयन्त इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that they do not burn even when anger burns themselves, but are overcome by anger.; नु अहो सोऽयं रोषो यद्-अन्तरं यन्-मध्यं प्रविशन्न् अलं बिभेति । — Oh, that’s the anger that’s in the middle of what you’re afraid of, and you’re afraid of it.; यद् वा, यस्यान्तर् मनः । — or whatever, within which the mind.; कथं-भूतम्? — How-ever it happened?; अमलं निर्मलं प्रविशन्न् इति ॥७॥ — entering into the immaculate and pure.
7.translation: Where even anger, which conquers lust, is afraid, where lust does not prevail, what is to be said? The creators, headed by Sri and Rudra, burn lust with their angry gaze. This means that they do not burn even when anger burns themselves, but are overcome by anger. Oh, that’s the anger that’s in the middle of what you’re afraid of, and you’re afraid of it. or whatever, within which the mind. How-ever it happened? entering into the immaculate and pure.

8.word_for_word: चरित्रेणैव कम् अप्य् अवतारं सूचयति । — The character itself indicates any incarnation.; मातुः सपत्न्याः उदितान्य् उक्तानि वाक्यान्य् एव पत्रिणो बाणाः, तैर् विद्धो ध्रुवो राज्ञ उत्तानपदोऽन्ति समीपे तपसे तपस् तप्तुम् । — The words spoken by his mother’s co-wife were the same as the arrows of the birds, and they pierced Dhruva, who was about to perform austerities near King Uttanapada.; ध्रुव-गतिं ध्रुव-पदम् । — The pole-motion is the pole-step.; यत् याम् उपरि स्थिताम् अधस्तात् स्थिता दिवि भवा दिव्याः सप्तर्षयः स्तुवन्ति । — The seven divine sages, who are situated above and below, praise the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; यद् वा, उपरि भृग्व्-आदयः अधस्तात् सप्तर्षय इति ॥८॥ — That is, Bhrigu and others above and the seven sages below.
8.translation: The character itself indicates any incarnation. The words spoken by his mother’s co-wife were the same as the arrows of the birds, and they pierced Dhruva, who was about to perform austerities near King Uttanapada. The pole-motion is the pole-step. The seven divine sages, who are situated above and below, praise the Supreme Personality of Godhead. That is, Bhrigu and others above and the seven sages below.

9.word_for_word: पृथ्व्-अवतारम् आह । — He said the earthly incarnation.; यद् यदा ऋषिभिर् अर्थितस् तदा वेनं त्रात्वा अन्वर्थं तत् पुत्र इति पदं नाम लेभे । — When the sages asked him to do so, he saved Vena and received the title of son of Anvartha.; पुं-नाम्नो नरकाद् यस्मात् पितरं त्रायते सुतः । — The son saves his father from the hell called Pun.; तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः स्वयम् एव स्वयंभुवा ॥ — Therefore, the self-born Lord Himself called him His son.; जगति भू-लोके पुत्र-प्रदं मथितवेन भुजोत्पन्नत्वात् पुत्रेण प्राप्यं राज्यं लेभे इति तीर्थः । — It is a holy place that he received the kingdom that his son would receive because he was born from the arm of Mathitava, who gave birth to sons in the world of the earth.; जगतीति निमित्ते सप्तमी अत आह । — The seventh in the occasion of the world, therefore, argues.; जगद्-अर्थम् इति ॥९॥ — for the sake of the universe.
9.translation: He said the earthly incarnation. When the sages asked him to do so, he saved Vena and received the title of son of Anvartha. The son saves his father from the hell called Pun. Therefore, the self-born Lord Himself called him His son. It is a holy place that he received the kingdom that his son would receive because he was born from the arm of Mathitava, who gave birth to sons in the world of the earth. The seventh in the occasion of the world, therefore, argues. for the sake of the universe.

10.word_for_word: ऋषभावतारम् आह । — He said to the star of the sage’s mood.; असौ हरिर् नाभेर् आग्नीध्र-पुत्रात् सुदेव्याः सूनुर् आस । — This Hari was the son of Sudevī, the son of Āgnīdhra, the son of Nābhi.; नाभेर् भार्याया मेरुदेव्या एव सुदेवीत्य् अपि संज्ञा । — Merudevī, the wife of Nābhi, is also known as Sudevī.; जडवद् योगेन नित्य-समाधिना चर्याम् । — Like a dull person, I should practice yoga and daily meditation.; यद् इति याम् । — Yad is Yam.; तत्र हेतुः—सम-दृक् । — The reason for this is—equal-seeing.; तत्रापि हेतुः—स्व-स्थः स्व-स्वरूपे स्थितः । — There is also a reason—he is self-contained and self-contained.; यतः प्रशान्तेन्द्रियः । — Because he is a calm sense.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; यतः परितो मुक्त-सङ्गः ॥१०॥ — Because of the free-attachment around.
10.translation: He said to the star of the sage’s mood. This Hari was the son of Sudevī, the son of Āgnīdhra, the son of Nābhi. Merudevī, the wife of Nābhi, is also known as Sudevī. Like a dull person, I should practice yoga and daily meditation. Yad is Yam. The reason for this is—equal-seeing. There is also a reason—he is self-contained and self-contained. Because he is a calm sense. Where is that from? Because of the free-attachment around.

11.word_for_word: हयग्रीवावतारम् आह—सत्रे इति । — The incarnation of the horse’s neck is said to be in the sacrifice.; अथो इत्य् अर्थान्तरे । — Atho, in the other sense.; स एव साक्षाद् भगवान् मम ब्रह्मणः सत्रे यज्ञे हयशीर्षा आस । — That very same Supreme Personality of Godhead, who was the head of the horse, was present at the sacrifice performed by my brāhmaṇas.; तपनीयं सुवर्णं तद्वद् वर्णो यस्य । — The color of gold is the same as that of heating gold.; छन्दो-मयो वेदमयः तद्-विधेया ये मखास् तन्-मयः । — The chandas are made up of the Vedas and the sacrifices performed by them are made up of them.; अमृतमय इति वा पाठः । — or the text, nectar-bearing.; मखैर् यजनीया अखिला देवतास् तद्-आत्मा च । — All the demigods and their souls are to be sacrificed by sacrifices.; अस्य श्वसतः श्वासं मुञ्चतो नस्तो नासा-पुटाद् उशतीर् उशत्यः कमनीया वेद-लक्षणा वाचो बभूवुः ॥११॥ — As he breathed in and released his breath from the nostrils came forth the beautiful words characteristic of the Vedas.
11.translation: The incarnation of the horse’s neck is said to be in the sacrifice. Atho, in the other sense. That very same Supreme Personality of Godhead, who was the head of the horse, was present at the sacrifice performed by my brāhmaṇas. The color of gold is the same as that of heating gold. The chandas are made up of the Vedas and the sacrifices performed by them are made up of them. or the text, nectar-bearing. All the demigods and their souls are to be sacrificed by sacrifices. As he breathed in and released his breath from the nostrils came forth the beautiful words characteristic of the Vedas.

12.word_for_word: मत्स्यावतारम् आह । — He said the fish incarnation.; मत्स्यो भाविना वैवस्वतेन मनुना दृष्टः । — The fish was seen by the future Vaivasvata Manu.; क्षोणीमयः पृथ्वी-प्रधानः, तद्-आश्रय इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the lowly is predominantly earthly and depends on it.; अत एव निखिल-जीव-निकायानाम् आश्रयः । — That is why it is the shelter of all living bodies.; मे मुखाद् विस्रंसितान् गलितान् वेदस्य मार्गान् वेदान् आदाय तत्र युगान्त-सलिले विजहार । — He took the paths of the Vedas that had melted away from my mouth and enjoyed them there in the waters of the end of the ages.; ह हर्षेण ॥१२॥ — H with joy.
12.translation: He said the fish incarnation. The fish was seen by the future Vaivasvata Manu. This means that the lowly is predominantly earthly and depends on it. That is why it is the shelter of all living bodies. He took the paths of the Vedas that had melted away from my mouth and enjoyed them there in the waters of the end of the ages. H with joy.

13.word_for_word: कूर्मावतारम् आह । — He said the tortoise incarnation.; क्षीरोदधौ कच्छप-वपुः सन् गोत्रं मन्थनार्थं मन्दर-गिरिं पृष्ठेन धृतवान् । — In the form of a tortoise in the ocean of milk he carried Mount Mandara on his back to churn the tribe; कदा ? — When?; अमृत-लब्धये क्षिराब्धिम् उन्मथ्नतां सताम् । — The virtuous are churning the ocean of milk in order to obtain nectar.; निद्रायाः क्षणोऽवसर उत्सवो वा यस्य सः । — A moment of sleep, an opportunity or a celebration.; निद्रावसरः कुतः ? — Where is the opportunity to sleep?; तत्राह—अद्रेः परिवर्तः परिभ्रम एव कषाणः कषणं घर्षण-सुख-प्रदो यस्यां सा कण्डूर् यस्य सः । — There he says: The change of the mountain is the rotation of the mountain, and the itching in which it gives friction and pleasure is the itching.; यद् वा, अद्रि-परिवर्त एव कषः कषणं तेन अणिति अपयातीति कषाणा कण्डूर् यस्य ॥१३॥ — That is, the itching of the mountain is the same as the itching of the powder, which is the itching of the powder.
13.translation: He said the tortoise incarnation. In the form of a tortoise in the ocean of milk he carried Mount Mandara on his back to churn the tribe When? The virtuous are churning the ocean of milk in order to obtain nectar. A moment of sleep, an opportunity or a celebration. Where is the opportunity to sleep? There he says: The change of the mountain is the rotation of the mountain, and the itching in which it gives friction and pleasure is the itching. That is, the itching of the mountain is the same as the itching of the powder, which is the itching of the powder.

14.word_for_word: श्री-नृसिंहावतारम् आह । — He said the incarnation of Sri-Nrishimha.; त्रैपिष्टपा देवास् तेषाम् उरु-भयं हन्तीति तथा स भगवान् । — The gods of the three worlds kill the fear of their thighs, and so does the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; यद् वा, त्रैपिष्टपानां देवानाम् अप्य् उरु-भयं यस्मात् तादृशो हासो यस्य तन् नृसिंह-रूपम् । — Or rather, the form of Nṛsiṁhadeva, whose laughter is so frightening even to the demigods of the three worlds, is called Nṛsiṁhadeva.; अथवा हिरण्यकशिपो राज्य-काले त्रैपिष्टपानां दैत्यानाम् उरु-भयं यस्मात् तादृशो हासो यस्य तन् नृसिंह-रूपम् । — Or maybe it is the form of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva whose laughter is such that Hiraṇyakaśipu, during his reign, was so frightening to the demons who ruled the three worlds.; कथम्भूतम् ? — How did it happen?; भ्रमन्त्यौ भ्रुकुट्यौ दंष्ट्राश् च यस्मिंस् तत् करालं वक्त्रं यस्मिंस् तत् । — That terrible face in which his eyebrows and fangs rotated; दैत्येन्द्रं स्फुरन्तम् आरात् समीप एव गदया उपलक्षितम् अभिपतन्तं नखैर् विददार ॥१४॥ — He pierced with his nails the lord of the demons who was trembling from the beginning and who was approaching him with his club
14.translation: He said the incarnation of Sri-Nrishimha. The gods of the three worlds kill the fear of their thighs, and so does the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Or rather, the form of Nṛsiṁhadeva, whose laughter is so frightening even to the demigods of the three worlds, is called Nṛsiṁhadeva. Or maybe it is the form of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva whose laughter is such that Hiraṇyakaśipu, during his reign, was so frightening to the demons who ruled the three worlds. How did it happen? That terrible face in which his eyebrows and fangs rotated He pierced with his nails the lord of the demons who was trembling from the beginning and who was approaching him with his club

15.word_for_word: हरि-संज्ञकावतारम् आह—अन्तर् इति युगलेन । — The incarnation of Hari is called Antar by the pair.; गज-यूथस्य पतिः । — The husband of a herd of elephants.; तीर्थ-रूपं श्रवो यशो यस्य स तीर्थ-श्रवाः, हे तीर्थ-श्रवः ! — He whose fame is the form of a holy place is the holy place, O holy place!; श्रवणेन एव मङ्गलं नामधेयं यस्य सः ॥१५॥ — He whose name is auspicious by hearing it alone.
15.translation: The incarnation of Hari is called Antar by the pair. The husband of a herd of elephants. He whose fame is the form of a holy place is the holy place, O holy place! He whose name is auspicious by hearing it alone.

16.word_for_word: तद्-वचनं श्रुत्वा शरणार्थिनं तं हस्ते शुण्डायां प्रगृह्य । — Hearing the words of the demon who was seeking refuge in the king he took him by the hand in his beard; किं कृत्वा । — What’s the difference?; नक्रस्य ग्राहस्य वदनं विनिपाट्य विदार्य । — The crocodile ripped open the crocodile’s face.; तस्मात् तद्-वदनात् ॥१६॥ — Therefore, from that-face.
16.translation: Hearing the words of the demon who was seeking refuge in the king he took him by the hand in his beard What’s the difference? The crocodile ripped open the crocodile’s face. Therefore, from that-face.

17.word_for_word: वामनावतारम् आह । — He said the Vamana incarnation.; अदितेः सुतानां द्वादशादित्यानां मध्ये अधियज्ञो यज्ञाधिष्ठाता विष्णुः । — Among the twelve sons of Aditi, Lord Viṣṇu is the chief sacrificer and the presiding deity of sacrifice.; अवरजः कनीयान् अपि गुणैर् ज्यायाञ् ज्येष्ठः । — The younger son is the older one who is more virtuous than the younger one.; गुणान् एवाह । — He called the virtues.; यद्य् अत इमांल् लोकान् विचक्रमे पाद-न्यासैः क्रान्तवान् । — If, therefore, he wandered about these worlds, he would have crossed them with his feet.; अथ प्रतिश्रुतानन्तरम् एव । — Then, immediately after the promise.; तत्र हेतुः—बलेः क्ष्मां वामन-रूपेण जगृहे । — The reason for this is that Bali took the earth in the form of a dwarf.; नन्व् ईश्वरः स्वयं किम् इति दुर्बलवत् तथा चक्रे ? — Why, then, did God Himself act so weakly?; तत्राह—याच्ञां विना धर्म-मार्गे वर्तमानो न चाल्यः, ऐश्वर्यान् न भ्रंशनीय इति ॥१७॥ — There he argues that one who is on the path of righteousness without begging should not be moved nor should he be deprived of his wealth.
17.translation: He said the Vamana incarnation. Among the twelve sons of Aditi, Lord Viṣṇu is the chief sacrificer and the presiding deity of sacrifice. The younger son is the older one who is more virtuous than the younger one. He called the virtues. If, therefore, he wandered about these worlds, he would have crossed them with his feet. Then, immediately after the promise. The reason for this is that Bali took the earth in the form of a dwarf. Why, then, did God Himself act so weakly? There he argues that one who is on the path of righteousness without begging should not be moved nor should he be deprived of his wealth.

18.word_for_word: ननु तर्हि याच्ञयापि चालनम् अनुचितम् एवेत्य् आशङ्क्य, ततोऽधिकं स्व-सालोक्यादि दास्यामीत्य् आशयेन हृतवान् इत्य् आह—नार्थ इति । — If so, then, suspecting that it was improper to move even by begging, he argued that he had taken it with the intention of giving him more than that, such as his own light.; यद् विबुधाधिपत्यम् इदानीं बलात् प्राप्तम् अग्रे दीयमानं चायं बलेः पुरुषार्थो न भवति । — The tea that Bali has now obtained by force and is being given in the future is not the purpose of Bali’s man.; कुत इत्य् अत आह । — Where, then, he argues.; आ अप इति च्छेदः । — Aa up is the cut.; उरुक्रमस्य पाद-शौचं चरण-क्षालन-रूपा अपः आ सर्वतो धृतवतः । — The water in the form of washing the feet of Urukrama was carried from all sides.; क्व ? — Where?; शिखा शिखायाम् । — Shikha in the crest.; मूर्ध्नीत्य् अर्थः । — It means the head.; किं च, शुक्रेण वारितः शप्तोऽप्य् अङ्ग हे नारद, यः प्रतिश्रुतं विना अन्यन् न चिकीर्षत् कर्तुं नैच्छत् । — Moreover, O Nārada, even though he was cursed by Venus, he did not want to do anything but what he had promised.; यश् च तृतीय-पाद-पूरणार्थं हरये आत्मानं देहम् अप्य् अभिमेनेऽङ्गीकृतवान् । — And he who, in order to fulfill the third leg, proudly accepted his own body for the Lord Hari.; एवं स-देहं त्रैलोक्यं श्रद्धया दत्तवतो विबुधाधिपत्यम् अर्थो न भवतीत्य् अर्थः ॥१८॥ — This means that one who thus gives the three worlds with his body with faith does not attain the kingdom of the demigods.
18.translation: If so, then, suspecting that it was improper to move even by begging, he argued that he had taken it with the intention of giving him more than that, such as his own light. The tea that Bali has now obtained by force and is being given in the future is not the purpose of Bali’s man. Where, then, he argues. Aa up is the cut. The water in the form of washing the feet of Urukrama was carried from all sides. Where? Shikha in the crest. It means the head. Moreover, O Nārada, even though he was cursed by Venus, he did not want to do anything but what he had promised. And he who, in order to fulfill the third leg, proudly accepted his own body for the Lord Hari. This means that one who thus gives the three worlds with his body with faith does not attain the kingdom of the demigods.

19.word_for_word: हंसावतारम् आह—तुभ्यम् इति । — He said to the swan incarnation, “To you.; भृशं विवृद्धेन भावेनात्युद्रिक्तया भक्त्या परितुष्टः सन् भक्ति-योगं साधु यथा तथा उवाच । — Satisfied with his greatly enhanced devotion to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa explained the yoga of devotional service as it was.; ज्ञानं चेति ज्ञान-साधनम् । — and knowledge is the means of knowledge.; किं तत् ? — What is that ?; भागवतं नाम । — Bhagavatam is the name.; कथम्भूतम् ? — How did it happen?; तत्त्वम् एव स-तत्त्वम् । — The essence is the co-essence.; आत्म-तत्त्व-दीपकम् । — The lamp of the Self-Essence.; विवृद्ध-भावेनेति विशेषणस्य फलम् आह—यद् इति ॥१९॥ — The result of the adjective by the increased sense is argued as follows
19.translation: He said to the swan incarnation, “To you. Satisfied with his greatly enhanced devotion to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa explained the yoga of devotional service as it was. and knowledge is the means of knowledge. What is that ? Bhagavatam is the name. How did it happen? The essence is the co-essence. The lamp of the Self-Essence. The result of the adjective by the increased sense is argued as follows

20.word_for_word: तत् तन् मन्वन्तरावतारम् आह—चक्रम् इति । — That is what he called the incarnation of the Manvantara, the wheel.; स्व-तेजो निजं प्रभावम् एव चक्रं सुदर्शनं बिभर्ति । — It is its own effulgence and its own influence that carries the Sudarśana wheel.; चक्रवद् अप्रतिहतं प्रभावं बिभर्तीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that it carries an unstoppable effect like a wheel.; तद् एवाह । — That’s what he said.; मनु-वंश-पालकः सन् त्रयाणां लोकानां पृष्ठे उपरि स्थिते सत्यलोकेऽपि कमनीयां स्व-कीर्तिं विस्तारयन् राजसु दण्डं विधत्ते ॥२०॥ — He is the protector of the Manu dynasty and is situated on the back of the three worlds and spreads his beloved fame even in the world of truth and imposes punishment on kings.
20.translation: That is what he called the incarnation of the Manvantara, the wheel. It is its own effulgence and its own influence that carries the Sudarśana wheel. This means that it carries an unstoppable effect like a wheel. That’s what he said. He is the protector of the Manu dynasty and is situated on the back of the three worlds and spreads his beloved fame even in the world of truth and imposes punishment on kings.

21.word_for_word: धन्वन्तर्य्-अवतारम् आह । — He said of the incarnation of Dhanvantari.; लोकेऽवतीर्य धन्वन्तरिः सन् पुरु-रुजां महा-रोगिणां स्व-नाम्नैव रुजो रोगान् हन्ति । — When Dhanvantari descends into this world, he kills the diseases of the great patients by his own name.; स्वयम् एव कीर्तिर् इति कीर्त्य्-अतिशयोक्तिः । — Fame itself is an exaggeration of fame.; अमृतं मरण-शून्यम् आयुर् यस्मात् सः । — He is the one from whom life is immortal and death-free.; अव अवसन्नं पूर्वं दैत्यैः प्रतिबद्धं यज्ञे भागम् अवरुन्धे लभते । — Ava, who has fallen down, obtains his share in the sacrifice previously promised by the demons.; “अवाप रुद्धम्” इति पाठेऽप्य् अयम् एवार्थः । — The same meaning is given in the text “Avapa ruddham”.; आयुर् विषयं वेदं चानुशास्ति प्रवर्तयति ॥२१॥ — Life disciplines and enforces the objects and the Vedas.
21.translation: He said of the incarnation of Dhanvantari. When Dhanvantari descends into this world, he kills the diseases of the great patients by his own name. Fame itself is an exaggeration of fame. He is the one from whom life is immortal and death-free. Ava, who has fallen down, obtains his share in the sacrifice previously promised by the demons. The same meaning is given in the text “Avapa ruddham”. Life disciplines and enforces the objects and the Vedas.

22.word_for_word: परशुरामावतारम् आह । — He said of the incarnation of Parasurama.; जगतः क्षयाय विधिना दैवेन उपभृतं संवर्धितं, मृत्यवे समर्पितम् इति वा । — It is said that the world has been brought up by fate in accordance with the law for its destruction, or it has been devoted to death.; ब्राह्मणेभ्यो द्रुह्यतीति तथा अत उज्झितः पन्था वेद-मार्गो येन । — He is angry with the brāhmaṇas and therefore has abandoned the path of the Vedas.; अत एव नरकार्तिं लिप्सति इव । — That is why he seems to desire the torment of hell.; एवम्-भूतम् अवनेः कण्टक-तुल्यं क्षत्रम् असौ महात्मा हरिर् उद्धन्त्य् उत्पाटयति, दीर्घ-तीक्ष्ण-धारेण परशुना ॥२२॥ — That great soul Hari with his long sharp-edged ax lifts up and uproots the kṣatriyas who have thus become like thorns in the earth
22.translation: He said of the incarnation of Parasurama. It is said that the world has been brought up by fate in accordance with the law for its destruction, or it has been devoted to death. He is angry with the brāhmaṇas and therefore has abandoned the path of the Vedas. That is why he seems to desire the torment of hell. That great soul Hari with his long sharp-edged ax lifts up and uproots the kṣatriyas who have thus become like thorns in the earth

23.word_for_word: रामावतारम् आह त्रिभिः—अस्मद् इति । — He called the incarnation of Rama in three ways—ours.; अस्माकं ब्रह्मादीनां प्रसादे सुमुखः, कलया भरतादि-रूपया सह, कला माया तस्या ईशो गुरोर् दशरथस्याज्ञायां तिष्ठन् सीता-लक्षणाभ्यां सहितो वनम् अविवेश । — By the grace of our Brahma and others, the beautiful-faced, with Kala in the form of Bharata and others, Kala Maya, staying at the command of her lord Dasaratha, entered the forest with the characteristics of Sita.; यस्मिन् विरोधं कृत्वा रावणो नाशं प्राप्तः ॥२३॥ — Ravana was destroyed by opposing him
23.translation: He called the incarnation of Rama in three ways—ours. By the grace of our Brahma and others, the beautiful-faced, with Kala in the form of Bharata and others, Kala Maya, staying at the command of her lord Dasaratha, entered the forest with the characteristics of Sita. Ravana was destroyed by opposing him

24.word_for_word: यस्मै रामाय उदधिर् मार्गं ददौ । — To whom the ocean gave way to Rama; सपदि शीघ्रं हरो यथा त्रिपुरं दिधक्षुस् तद्वद् अरिपुरं लङ्कां दग्धुम् इच्छतोः । — They wanted to burn down the enemy city of Lanka just as Lord Hari wanted to burn down the three cities at once.; षष्ठी चतुर्थ्य्-अर्थे । — The sixth in the fourth sense.; यद् वा, पञ्चमीयम् । — or, the fifth.; दिधक्षोः रामाद् यद् भयं प्राप्तं, तेन अङ्गे कम्पो यस्येति । — The fear that he had received from Rama, who was about to burn, caused him to tremble in his body.; कथम्भूत उदधिः ? — What kind of ocean?; ऊढं प्राप्तं यद् भयं तेनाङ्गेषु वेपः कम्पो यस्य । — The fear that has come upon him causes him to tremble in his limbs.; अत्र हेतुः—दूरे वर्तमाना सुहृत् सीता, तया निमित्त-भूतया मथितः क्षुभितो रोषः, तेन सुशोणा अत्यरुणा दृष्टिः, तयाऽत्यन्तं तप्यमानं मकराणाम् उरगाणां नक्राणां च चक्रं यस्मिन् ॥२४॥ — The reason for this is that Sita, her friend, is far away, her anger is stirred by the occasion, her eyes are very red, and she is very much tormented by the wheel of sharks, serpents and crocodiles.
24.translation: To whom the ocean gave way to Rama They wanted to burn down the enemy city of Lanka just as Lord Hari wanted to burn down the three cities at once. The sixth in the fourth sense. or, the fifth. The fear that he had received from Rama, who was about to burn, caused him to tremble in his body. What kind of ocean? The fear that has come upon him causes him to tremble in his limbs. The reason for this is that Sita, her friend, is far away, her anger is stirred by the occasion, her eyes are very red, and she is very much tormented by the wheel of sharks, serpents and crocodiles.

25.word_for_word: किं च, युद्धे रावणस्य वक्षः-स्थल-स्पर्शेन रुग्णा भग्ना ये महेन्द्र-वाहस्य ऐरावतस्य दन्ताः, तैर् विडम्बिताः स्व-धवलिम्ना धवलीकृताः, तत्-तद्-दिक्षु पतितैः प्रकाशिता इत्य् अर्थः । — Moreover, it means that the teeth of Airavata, the horse of Indra, which were sickly broken by the touch of Ravana’s chest in battle, were mocked by them, whitened with their own whiteness, and illuminated by those who fell in those directions.; या एवम्भूताः ककुभो दिशः, ता जुषते सेवते पालयतीति वा, तथा तस्य दार-हर्तू रावणस्य “अहो मत्-समः कोऽन्योऽस्ति” इति महा-गर्वेण ऊढं प्राप्तं हासम् असुभिः प्राणैः सह सद्यः शीघ्रं विनेष्यत्य् अपनेष्यति । — The directions of the sky which are thus formed, which he enjoys, serves and protects, will immediately and quickly destroy the smile of Ravana, the thief of his door, who has received it with great pride, saying, “Oh, who is like me?”; कैः ? — Who?; धनुषो विस्फूर्जितैः टङ्कार-घोषैर् एव ॥२५॥ — The bows were whistled and the tinkling sounds were heard.
25.translation: Moreover, it means that the teeth of Airavata, the horse of Indra, which were sickly broken by the touch of Ravana’s chest in battle, were mocked by them, whitened with their own whiteness, and illuminated by those who fell in those directions. The directions of the sky which are thus formed, which he enjoys, serves and protects, will immediately and quickly destroy the smile of Ravana, the thief of his door, who has received it with great pride, saying, “Oh, who is like me?” Who? The bows were whistled and the tinkling sounds were heard.

26.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्णावतारम् आह—भूमेर् इति दशभिः । — He said of the incarnation of Lord Kṛṣṇa: Bhūmer, with ten.; सुरेतरा असुरांश-भूता राजानस् तेषां वरूथैः सैन्यैर् विमर्दिताया भारेण पीडितायाः । — The kings, who were other than the gods, were part of the demons, and were crushed by the weight of their armies.; कलया रामेण सह जातः सन् । — Being born with Kalya and Rama.; कोऽसौ जातः? — Who was he born?; सित-कृष्णौ केशौ यस्य भगवतः स एव साक्षात् । — He who has white and black hair is the very same Lord.; सित-कृष्ण-केशत्वं शोभैव न तु वयः-परिणाम-कृतम्, अविकारित्वात् । — White or black hair is beauty, not the result of age, since it is invariable.; ... कर्माणि कीदृशानि ? — ... What are the actions like?; आत्मनो महिमा उपनिबध्यतेऽभिव्यज्यते येषु तानि ॥२६॥ — The glory of the Self is bound up in those things in which it is expressed.
26.translation: He said of the incarnation of Lord Kṛṣṇa: Bhūmer, with ten. The kings, who were other than the gods, were part of the demons, and were crushed by the weight of their armies. Being born with Kalya and Rama. Who was he born? He who has white and black hair is the very same Lord. White or black hair is beauty, not the result of age, since it is invariable. ... What are the actions like? The glory of the Self is bound up in those things in which it is expressed.

27.word_for_word: एतद् एव प्रपञ्चयति—तोकेनेत्य्-आदिना । — This is what he argues—by the token, etc.; बालेन पूतनाया जीव-हरणम् । — The child’s killing of Pūtanā.; यद् रिङ्गता जानुभ्यां गच्छता अन्तरं गतेन मध्यं प्राप्तेन । — That’s what rings when you’re on your knees, going through the gap, and reaching the middle.; दिवि-स्पृशोर् अत्युच्चयोः । — Heaven-touching and very high.; इतरथाऽनीश्वरत्वे तन् न भवितव्यम् ॥२७॥ — Otherwise, in the absence of God, that should not be the case.
27.translation: This is what he argues—by the token, etc. The child’s killing of Pūtanā. That’s what rings when you’re on your knees, going through the gap, and reaching the middle. Heaven-touching and very high. Otherwise, in the absence of God, that should not be the case.

28.word_for_word: विष-तोय-पीतान् विषमय-तोयस्य पीतं पानं येषां तान् पालान् गोपांश् च कृपा-दृष्टि-सुधा-वृष्ट्या जीवयिष्यतीति । — He will revive the shepherds and cowherd men who have drunk the poisonous water by showering them with the nectar of His merciful sight.; यमुनायां क्रीडन्न् उरगं कालियम् उच्चाटयिष्यति । — Playing in the Yamuna, he will utter the serpent Kāliya.; तच्-छुद्धये तस्या ह्रदिन्या निर्विषत्वाय । — To cleanse that lake and make it detoxify.; अतिविष-वीर्येण विलोलाऽतिचञ्चला जिह्वा यस्य ॥२८॥ — His tongue is very restless and stirred with the power of excessive poison.
28.translation: He will revive the shepherds and cowherd men who have drunk the poisonous water by showering them with the nectar of His merciful sight. Playing in the Yamuna, he will utter the serpent Kāliya. To cleanse that lake and make it detoxify. His tongue is very restless and stirred with the power of excessive poison.

29.word_for_word: दिव्यम् अलौकिकम् इव इति लोकोक्तिः । — The proverb says that the divine is like the supernatural.; उन्नेष्यत्य् उद्धरिष्यति । — He will raise and lift.; शुचिर् ग्रीष्मस् तत्-सम्बन्धिनि वने । — It was a clean summer in the forest belonging to it.; शुष्क इत्य् अर्थः । — It means dry.; अतो दावाग्नेर् हेतोर् अवसितो निश्चितोऽन्त-कालो यस्य तम् । — Therefore, the cause of the fire of claim is determined by the fixed end time.; स-बलः स-रामः । — Sa-bala is Sa-Rama.; अनधिगम्यं दुर्ज्ञेयं वीर्यं यस्य । — whose power is unattainable and difficult to understand.; ... नेत्रे पिधाप्य पिहिते कारयित्वेति ॥२९॥ — ... closed his eyes and made him close them.
29.translation: The proverb says that the divine is like the supernatural. He will raise and lift. It was a clean summer in the forest belonging to it. It means dry. Therefore, the cause of the fire of claim is determined by the fixed end time. Sa-bala is Sa-Rama. whose power is unattainable and difficult to understand. ... closed his eyes and made him close them.

30.word_for_word: उपबध्यतेऽनेनेत्य् उपबन्धं तत्-साधनं शुल्बं दाम अमुष्य माता यशोदाऽग्रहीत् । — The mother of the child, Yaśodā, took the śulba, the means of the bond, which was the means of the bond.; अमुष्योदरे न माति बन्धन-संमितं न भवति, न पूर्यत इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the abdomen of this man is not measured by the bondage of the matter, nor is it filled.; गोपी यशोदा संवीक्ष्य दृष्ट्वा प्रतिबोधिता निजैश्वर्यं ज्ञापिता आसीद् इति यत्, तच् च कर्म दिव्यम् इवेति सर्वत्र पूर्वेणान्वयः ॥३०॥ — That the gopī Yaśodā, having looked at her and seen her, was awakened and informed of her own opulence, and that act seems to be a divine act, is the consequence of the former everywhere.
30.translation: The mother of the child, Yaśodā, took the śulba, the means of the bond, which was the means of the bond. This means that the abdomen of this man is not measured by the bondage of the matter, nor is it filled. That the gopī Yaśodā, having looked at her and seen her, was awakened and informed of her own opulence, and that act seems to be a divine act, is the consequence of the former everywhere.

31.word_for_word: वरुणस्य पाशाद् यद् भयं तस्मान् मोचयिष्यति । — He will free us from the fear of the noose of Varuna.; मय-सूनुना व्योम-नाम्ना । — By the son of Maya, Vyoma.; अह्नि आपृतं व्यापार-युक्तं निशि शयानम् इति च वैकुण्ठ-प्राप्ति-साधनानुष्ठानाभावो दर्शितः । — The fact that one is busy during the day and engaged in business and lying down at night shows the absence of performing the means of attaining Vaikuṇṭha.; उपनेष्यति प्रापयिष्यति गोकुल-वासिनं जनम् । — He will bring and deliver the people who live in Gokula.; स्म इत्य् आश्चर्ये ॥३१॥ — We were surprised.
31.translation: He will free us from the fear of the noose of Varuna. By the son of Maya, Vyoma. The fact that one is busy during the day and engaged in business and lying down at night shows the absence of performing the means of attaining Vaikuṇṭha. He will bring and deliver the people who live in Gokula. We were surprised.

32.word_for_word: देवे इन्द्रे । — Deve Indra.; पशून् रिरक्षुः रिरक्षिषुर् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means to protect the animals.; अनघे श्रम-रहिते एकस्मिन्न् एव करे सलीलं यथा तथा महीध्रं गोवर्धनं धर्ता धारयिष्यति । — O sinless one, without fatigue, the holder will hold the Mahidhra Govardhana in one hand, just as it is playfully playful.; उच्छिलीन्ध्रम् उद्गतं छत्राकम् इव । — The hole in the skin is like an umbrella that has emerged.; सप्त-वर्षाणि वयो यस्य सः ॥३२॥ — He who is seven years old.
32.translation: Deve Indra. It means to protect the animals. O sinless one, without fatigue, the holder will hold the Mahidhra Govardhana in one hand, just as it is playfully playful. The hole in the skin is like an umbrella that has emerged. He who is seven years old.

33.word_for_word: निशि रात्रौ । — Night after night.; निशाकर-रश्मिभिर् गौर्यां धवलायाम् । — The night moon’s rays covered the white sky.; वने क्रीडन् कलानि मञ्जुलानि पदानि यस्मिंस् तच् च तद् आयतं दीर्घं मूर्च्छितम् आलाप-विशेष-युक्तं गतिं तेनोद्दीपितः स्मर एव रुक् यासां तासां गोपीनां हर्तुः शङ्खचूडस्य शिरो हरिष्यति ॥३३॥ — While he was playing in the forest with his arts and feet in which he was long and faint his movements were characterized by conversation and his movements were aroused by the lust which would snatch the head of the conchshell-crowned gopīs who had stolen them.
33.translation: Night after night. The night moon’s rays covered the white sky. While he was playing in the forest with his arts and feet in which he was long and faint his movements were characterized by conversation and his movements were aroused by the lust which would snatch the head of the conchshell-crowned gopīs who had stolen them.

34.word_for_word: ये च प्रलम्बादयस् ते सर्वे हरिणा हेतु-भूतेन तदीयं निलयम् अदर्शनं दर्शनायोग्यं वैकुण्ठम् अलं यास्यन्ति इत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः । — And all those who are like Pralamba will go to Vaikuṇṭha, the invisible abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the cause of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; खरो धेनुकः, दर्दुर इव दर्दुरो बकः, इभः कुवलयापीडः, कुजो नरकः, कपिर् द्विविदः ॥३४॥ — The donkey is a cow, the goat is as painful as the goat, the elephant is the tormentor of the well, the elephant is the hell, and the monkey is the two-legged.
34.translation: And all those who are like Pralamba will go to Vaikuṇṭha, the invisible abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the cause of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The donkey is a cow, the goat is as painful as the goat, the elephant is the tormentor of the well, the elephant is the hell, and the monkey is the two-legged.

35.word_for_word: समितौ सङ्ग्रामे शालन्ते श्लाघन्ते ते समिति-शालिनः । — They are the ones who are able to fight in the committee and they are the ones who are able to fight in the committee.; ननु प्रलम्ब-खर-कपि-बल्वल-रुक्मि-प्रमुखा बलभद्रेण निहताः, काम्बोजादयश् च भीमार्जुनादिभिः, शम्बरः प्रद्युम्नेन, यवनो मुचुकुन्देन, न तु हरिणा, तत्राह । — Indeed, Pralamba, Khara, Kapi, Balvala and Rukmi were killed by Balabhadra, Kamboja and others by Bhīma, Arjuna and others, Śambara by Pradyumna, and Yavana by Muchukunda, not by Hari.; बल-पार्थ-भीमा इत्य्-आदयो व्याजेनैवाह्वया नामानि यस्य तेन । — He whose names are called Bala, Partha, Bhīma and others by interest.; सप्तोक्षाणस् तु तेन दमिताः कालान्तरे यास्यन्तीति भावः । — This means that the seven okṣāṇas, however, will be suppressed by it and will pass away in time.; अत्र प्रलम्ब-खरादयः सायुज्यं, पौण्ड्रक-दन्तवक्रादयो वैकुण्ठं यास्यन्तीति विवेचनीयम् अग्रे व्याख्यास्यमान-युक्तेः ॥३४-३५॥ — Here it should be understood that Pralamba, Khara and others will be united, and that Paundraka, Dantavakra and others will go to Vaikuṇṭha, according to the logic to be explained later.
35.translation: They are the ones who are able to fight in the committee and they are the ones who are able to fight in the committee. Indeed, Pralamba, Khara, Kapi, Balvala and Rukmi were killed by Balabhadra, Kamboja and others by Bhīma, Arjuna and others, Śambara by Pradyumna, and Yavana by Muchukunda, not by Hari. He whose names are called Bala, Partha, Bhīma and others by interest. This means that the seven okṣāṇas, however, will be suppressed by it and will pass away in time. Here it should be understood that Pralamba, Khara and others will be united, and that Paundraka, Dantavakra and others will go to Vaikuṇṭha, according to the logic to be explained later.

36.word_for_word: व्यासावतारम् आह । — He said the incarnation of Vyasa.; अनुयुगं मीलिता संकुचिता धीर् येषाम् । — They have closed their minds and their patience has shrunk.; स्तोकम् अल्पम् आयुर् येषां तेषां स्व-निगमः स्व-कृतो वेद-राशिर् बताहो दूरे पारं यस्येति दुर्गम् इत्य् अवमृश्य सत्यवत्याम् आविर्भूतः सन् स एव हरिः । — For those whose life span is short, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, appeared to Satyavatī, thinking that the Vedas, which He had created for Himself, were difficult to cross.; विटपशः शाखा-भेदेन ॥३६॥ — Branches by the difference of branches.
36.translation: He said the incarnation of Vyasa. They have closed their minds and their patience has shrunk. For those whose life span is short, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, appeared to Satyavatī, thinking that the Vedas, which He had created for Himself, were difficult to cross. Branches by the difference of branches.

37.word_for_word: बुद्धावतारम् आह । — He said the Buddha’s incarnation.; देव-द्विषां निगम-वर्त्मनि वेद-मार्गे निष्ठितानां नितरां स्थितानाम् । — They are the enemies of the gods, and they are constantly following the path of the Vedas, which is the path of the Vedas.; तद्-बलेन च पूर्भिः पुरीभिः । — and by the strength of that, the ancient cities.; अदृश्य-तूर्भिर् अलक्ष्य-वेगाभिः । — With invisible trumpets and unnoticeable speeds.; मतेर् विमोहो योग्यता-त्यागो यस्मात्, मतेः प्रलोभश् चायुक्त-स्वीकारो यस्मात् तं पाषण्ड-वेषं विधाय तेन औपधर्म्यं पाषण्ड-धर्मम् । — The delusion of opinion, which is the renunciation of merit, and the temptation of opinion, which is the acceptance of the righteous, is the formal religion of heresy, which is disguised as heresy.; स्वार्थे ष्यञ् । — self-interested s.; बहु भाषिष्यत इत्य् अर्थः ॥३७॥ — This means that he will talk a lot.
37.translation: He said the Buddha’s incarnation. They are the enemies of the gods, and they are constantly following the path of the Vedas, which is the path of the Vedas. and by the strength of that, the ancient cities. With invisible trumpets and unnoticeable speeds. The delusion of opinion, which is the renunciation of merit, and the temptation of opinion, which is the acceptance of the righteous, is the formal religion of heresy, which is disguised as heresy. self-interested s. This means that he will talk a lot.

38.word_for_word: कल्क्य्-अवतारम् आह । — He said the incarnation of Kalki.; यर्हि यदा सताम् अप्य् आलयेषु गृहेषु हरेः कथा न स्युः । — Whenever, even in the homes of the pious, there is no story of the Lord.; त्रैवर्णिकाः पाषण्डिनः स्युः, शूद्राश् च राजानः स्युः, तदा कल्कि-रूपेण कलेः शास्ता भविष्यति । — When the trivarnikas become heretics and the śūdras become kings, then there will be the ruler of Kali in the form of Kalki.; अत्र च ब्रह्म-नारद-संवादात् प्राग्-भाविनो वराहादयः, मन्वन्तरावतारास् तु भूता भाविनश् च, धन्वन्तरि-परशुरामौ तदा वर्तेते, श्री-रामादयस् तु भाविनः, तत्र तु क्वचिद् भूतादि-निर्देशश् छान्दस इति द्रष्टव्यम् ॥३८॥ — Here, too, from the conversation between Brahma and Nārada, the boars and others were pre-existing, the incarnations of the Manvantaras were Bhūtas and future ones, Dhanvantari and Paraśurāma were then present, and Śrī Rāma and others were future, but somewhere the reference to Bhūtas and others is in the Chāndasa.
38.translation: He said the incarnation of Kalki. Whenever, even in the homes of the pious, there is no story of the Lord. When the trivarnikas become heretics and the śūdras become kings, then there will be the ruler of Kali in the form of Kalki. Here, too, from the conversation between Brahma and Nārada, the boars and others were pre-existing, the incarnations of the Manvantaras were Bhūtas and future ones, Dhanvantari and Paraśurāma were then present, and Śrī Rāma and others were future, but somewhere the reference to Bhūtas and others is in the Chāndasa.

39.word_for_word: सृष्ट्य्-आदि-कार्य-भेदेन माया-गुणावतार-विभूतीर् आह—सर्ग इति । — By distinguishing between the works of creation and others, he argues that the incarnations of the illusory modes of nature are the glories of creation.; स्थाने स्थितौ । — in position.; मखो विष्णुः । — Makho is Vishnu.; धर्मश् च मखश् च मनवश् च अमराश् च अवनीशाश् च । — The religion, the sacrifice, the Manus, the immortals and the lower classes.; अन्ते संहारे । — Finally, he destroyed.; हरो रुद्रः । — Haro is Rudra.; मन्यु-वशाः सर्पाः । — Snakes under the control of anger.; बहु-शक्ति-धारिणो भगवत इमा माया-विभूतयः ॥३९॥ — These illusory glories of the Supreme Personality of Godhead possess many powers.
39.translation: By distinguishing between the works of creation and others, he argues that the incarnations of the illusory modes of nature are the glories of creation. in position. Makho is Vishnu. The religion, the sacrifice, the Manus, the immortals and the lower classes. Finally, he destroyed. Haro is Rudra. Snakes under the control of anger. These illusory glories of the Supreme Personality of Godhead possess many powers.

40.word_for_word: इदं मया संक्षेपेणोक्तं विस्तरेण वक्तुं न कोऽपि समर्थ इत्य् आह । — I have briefly explained this and no one is able to explain it in detail; पृथिव्याः परमाणून् अपि यो विममे गणितवांस् तादृशोऽपि को नु विष्णोर् वीर्य-गणनां कर्तुम् अर्हति । — Who can count the power of Lord Viṣṇu, who has measured and counted the atoms of the earth?; कथम्भूतस्य ? — How about the ghost?; यो विष्णुस् त्रि-पृष्ठं सत्यलोकं चस्कम्भ धृतवान् । — Lord Viṣṇu, who holds the three-backed Satyaloka and the Chaskambha.; किम् इति चस्कम्भ ? — What is Chaskambha?; यस्मान् त्रैविक्रमेऽस्खलता प्रतिघात-शून्येन स्व-रंहसा स्व-पाद-वेगेन त्रि-साम्य-रूपं सदनम् अधिष्ठानं प्रधानं तस्माद् आरभ्योरुअधिकं कम्पयानं कम्पमानम् । — Since the threefold equality of the house, which is the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is free from slippage in the three worlds, who is free from obstacles and whose speed is the speed of His own feet, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is vibrating more than His thighs.; अतः कारणाच् चस्कम्भ ॥४०॥ — Hence the cause of the Chaskambha.
40.translation: I have briefly explained this and no one is able to explain it in detail Who can count the power of Lord Viṣṇu, who has measured and counted the atoms of the earth? How about the ghost? Lord Viṣṇu, who holds the three-backed Satyaloka and the Chaskambha. What is Chaskambha? Since the threefold equality of the house, which is the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is free from slippage in the three worlds, who is free from obstacles and whose speed is the speed of His own feet, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is vibrating more than His thighs. Hence the cause of the Chaskambha.

41.word_for_word: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति—नान्तम् इति । — This is what he argues—that it is not the end.; पुरुषस्य यन् माया-बलं तस्यान्तं न विदामि न वेद्मि । — I do not know the end of the illusory power of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; दश-शतान्य् आननानि यस्य स शेषोऽप्य् अस्य गुणान् गायन् पारं न समवस्यति न प्राप्नोति ॥४१॥ — He who has ten hundred faces and the rest of them singing His virtues does not reach the other side nor does He attain it.
41.translation: This is what he argues—that it is not the end. I do not know the end of the illusory power of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He who has ten hundred faces and the rest of them singing His virtues does not reach the other side nor does He attain it.

42.word_for_word: यदि न केऽपि विदन्ति, तर्हि कथं मुच्येरन् ? — If no one knows, how can they be freed?; तत् कृपयैव इत्य् आह—येषाम् इति । — That is, he argues, by grace—of whom.; दययेद् दयां कुर्यात् । — He should be merciful and show mercy.; ते च यदि निर्व्यलीकं निष्कपटम् आश्रित-चरणाः भवन्ति, ते दुस्तरां देव-मायाम् अतितरन्ति । — And if they are unfeigned and sincerely dependent on their feet, they will overcome the difficult illusion of the gods.; च-कारान् माया-वैभवं विदन्ति च । — They also know the glory of the illusory energy of the f-cars.; अथेति वा पाठः । — or the text, Athe.; प्रत्यक्षम् एव तेषां माया-तरणम् इत्य् आह—नैषाम् इति । — He argues that it is directly their illusory salvation—not theirs.; श्व-शृगालानां भक्ष्ये देहे ॥४२॥ — In the body of dogs and foxes as food.
42.translation: If no one knows, how can they be freed? That is, he argues, by grace—of whom. He should be merciful and show mercy. And if they are unfeigned and sincerely dependent on their feet, they will overcome the difficult illusion of the gods. They also know the glory of the illusory energy of the f-cars. or the text, Athe. He argues that it is directly their illusory salvation—not theirs. In the body of dogs and foxes as food.

43.word_for_word: अन्तर्-ज्ञानाभावेऽपि मायेयम् इति ज्ञानं तत्-कृपया बहूनाम् अस्तीत्य् आह—वेदाहम् इति त्रिभिः । — He argues that even in the absence of inner knowledge, knowledge that I am illusory is available to many by His grace—I know by three.; यूयम् इति सनकादीन् अन्तर्भाव्य बहुत्वम् । — You are a plural, including Sanaka and others.; दैत्य-वर्यः प्रह्लादः । — The demon-varya is Prahlada.; मनुः स्वायम्भुवस् तस्य पत्नी शतरूपा च । — Manu was the son of Svayambhuva and his wife was Śatarūpā.; तद्-आत्मजाः प्रिय-व्रतोत्तानपादौ पुत्रौ कन्याश् च । — His sons were Priya-vrata and Uttanapada, two sons and daughters.; प्राचीनबर्हिषो विसर्ग-लोपश् छान्दसः । — The ancient barhiṣa is a consonant-lop in the Chāndasa.; अङ्गो वेन-पिता ॥४३॥ — Ango Vena-pita.
43.translation: He argues that even in the absence of inner knowledge, knowledge that I am illusory is available to many by His grace—I know by three. You are a plural, including Sanaka and others. The demon-varya is Prahlada. Manu was the son of Svayambhuva and his wife was Śatarūpā. His sons were Priya-vrata and Uttanapada, two sons and daughters. The ancient barhiṣa is a consonant-lop in the Chāndasa. Ango Vena-pita.

44.word_for_word: शतधनुः अनुश् च । — and the hundred-bow and the Anu.; सन्धिर् आर्षः । — The treaty is the Arsha.; रन्तिदेवा इति पाठः सुगमः । — The text Rantideva is easy.; एक-पद्ये एतैः सहितो देवव्रत इत्य् अर्थः ॥४४॥ — In one verse, with these, it means the vow of the gods.
44.translation: and the hundred-bow and the Anu. The treaty is the Arsha. The text Rantideva is easy. In one verse, with these, it means the vow of the gods.

45.word_for_word: उपेन्द्रदत्तः शुकः । — Upendra Datta is a parrot.; विभीषणादयो वर्या मुख्या येषां ते ॥४५॥ — Vibhishana and other noble ones were the chief among them.
45.translation: Upendra Datta is a parrot. Vibhishana and other noble ones were the chief among them.

46.word_for_word: किं बहुना सत्-सङ्गेन सर्वेऽपि विदन्तीत्य् आह—ते वा इति । — What is it that everyone knows by association with the true?; अद्भुताः क्रमाः पाद-न्यासा यस्य हरेः, तत्-परायणास् तद्-भक्ताः, तेषां शीले शिक्षा येषां ते तथा यदि भवन्ति, तर्हि तेऽपि विदन्तीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the wonderful orders of the feet of the Lord, whose devotees are devoted to Him, and who have been taught in His character, if they are so, they too know.; श्रुत-धारणा ब्राह्मणास् ते देव-मायां विदन्तीति किम् उ वक्तव्यम् ? — What u should be said that the Brahmanas who have heard and held know the illusion of the gods?; शुभेति पाठे शुभे भगवतो रूपे धारणा मनो-नियमनं येषां, ते विदन्तीति किम् उ वक्तव्यम् ॥४६॥ — What is to be said of those whose minds are controlled by meditation on the auspicious form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in the text 'Auspicious'?
46.translation: What is it that everyone knows by association with the true? This means that the wonderful orders of the feet of the Lord, whose devotees are devoted to Him, and who have been taught in His character, if they are so, they too know. What u should be said that the Brahmanas who have heard and held know the illusion of the gods? What is to be said of those whose minds are controlled by meditation on the auspicious form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in the text 'Auspicious'?

47.word_for_word: किं तद्-भगवतः स्वरूपं यस्मिन् मनो-धारणां विधाय मायां तरन्ति ? — What is that form of the Lord in which they cross the illusion by placing mind-control?; इत्य् अपेक्षायाम् आह—शश्वद् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — In expectation of this, he argues that it is eternal, by two.; यद् ब्रह्मेति विदुर् मुनयः, तद् वै भगवतः पदं स्वरूपम् । — What the sages know as Brahman is the very form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; किं तद् ब्रह्म ? — What is that Brahman?; तद् आह—अजस्रं नित्यं च तत् सुखं च विशोकं चेति । — He argues that it is infinite and eternal, that is, happiness and freedom from sorrow.; अजस्र-सुखत्वे हेतुः—शश्वत् सदा प्रशान्तम् । — The reason for being infinitely happy—it is always peaceful.; अतो नित्य-सुख-रूपम् । — Therefore, it is the form of eternal happiness.; विशोकत्वे हेतुः—अभयम् । — The reason for being without grief—fearlessness.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; यतः समं भेद-शून्यम् । — Because it is equally difference-free.; अतोऽभयम् । — Therefore, it is safe.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; यतः प्रतिबोध-मात्रं ज्ञानैक-रसम् ॥४७-४८॥ — Because awakening alone is the only taste of knowledge.47-4
47.translation: What is that form of the Lord in which they cross the illusion by placing mind-control? In expectation of this, he argues that it is eternal, by two. What the sages know as Brahman is the very form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. What is that Brahman? He argues that it is infinite and eternal, that is, happiness and freedom from sorrow. The reason for being infinitely happy—it is always peaceful. Therefore, it is the form of eternal happiness. The reason for being without grief—fearlessness. Where is that from? Because it is equally difference-free. Therefore, it is safe. Where is that from? Because awakening alone is the only taste of knowledge.47-4

48.word_for_word: परमात्मानो ब्रह्मणश् च उपासकान् सामान्याकारेणाह । — The Supreme Soul and the worshipers of the Brahman are described in general terms.; सह अञ्चतीति सध्र्यक् सहचरं मनः । — The mind is rightly accompanied by the righteousness of the mind.; यं परमात्मनं, यत् ब्रह्म च प्रतिनियम्य यस्मिन् स्थिरीकृत्य । — The Supreme Soul, who is the Absolute Truth, is controlled and fixed in Him.; यतयो यत्न-शीला योगिनः सन्न्यासिनश् च । — They are ascetics, diligent yogis and renunciants.; कर्तो भेदस् तद्-अभावोऽकर्तः, तत्र हेतिं साधनम् । — The difference between the doer and the absence of it is the doer, where the cause is the means.; जह्युस् त्यजेयुः । — They should abandon and abandon.; अनुपयोगान् नाद्रियन्त इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that they do not appreciate the uselessness.; उपयोगाभावेन साधनानादरे दृष्टान्तः—निपानं कूपस् तस्य खनित्रं खनन-साधनम् । — An illustration of disrespect for tools due to lack of use—a well is a well and its digger is a digging tool.; यथा स्वराट् स्वयम् एव पर्जन्य-रूपेण विराजमान इन्द्रो नादत्ते तद्वत् ॥४८॥ — Just as Indra, the lord of the universe, who himself shines in the form of the rain, does not give anything.
48.translation: The Supreme Soul and the worshipers of the Brahman are described in general terms. The mind is rightly accompanied by the righteousness of the mind. The Supreme Soul, who is the Absolute Truth, is controlled and fixed in Him. They are ascetics, diligent yogis and renunciants. The difference between the doer and the absence of it is the doer, where the cause is the means. They should abandon and abandon. This means that they do not appreciate the uselessness. An illustration of disrespect for tools due to lack of use—a well is a well and its digger is a digging tool. Just as Indra, the lord of the universe, who himself shines in the form of the rain, does not give anything.

49.word_for_word: एवं तावद् अजस्र-सुखं विशोकं ब्रह्मैव भगवतः स्वरूपं तत्-प्राप्तानां च न प्राप्यं कृत्यं वा किंचिद् अस्तीत्य् उक्तम् । — Thus far, it has been said that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is free from infinite happiness and sorrow, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and that there is nothing to be attained or done by those who have attained Him.; इदानीं ततः प्राक् स एव सर्व-फल-दाता सर्व-कर्म-प्रवर्तकश् चेत्य् आह । — Now, before that, he argues that He is the giver of all fruits and the initiator of all actions.; स एव श्रेयसां फलानां विभुर् दातापि । — He is the master and the giver of the best of all fruits.; ... स्वारम्भक-धातूनां भूतानां विगमे वियोगे सति अन्व् अनु विशीर्यमाणेऽपि देहे तत्र-स्थं व्योम् एव यस् तेन सह न विशीर्यते । — ... When the beings of the self-initiating elements are separated and disintegrated, the sky itself in the body, which is there, does not disintegrate with it.; यतोऽजस् तेन सह न जातः ॥४९॥ — Because the unborn was not born with it.
49.translation: Thus far, it has been said that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is free from infinite happiness and sorrow, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and that there is nothing to be attained or done by those who have attained Him. Now, before that, he argues that He is the giver of all fruits and the initiator of all actions. He is the master and the giver of the best of all fruits. ... When the beings of the self-initiating elements are separated and disintegrated, the sky itself in the body, which is there, does not disintegrate with it. Because the unborn was not born with it.

50.word_for_word: अध्याय-त्रयस्यार्थम् उपसंहरति—सोऽयं ते समासेन संक्षेपेण अभिहितः । — He concludes the meaning of chapter three—that is what I have told you briefly in summary.; तम् एवाह—सद्-असत् कार्यं कारणं च हरेर् अन्यन् न भवति । — He said to himself, “There is no other cause of good and evil than the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; ननु हरेस् तद्-अव्यतिरेके तद्-गत-विकार-प्रसङ्गः स्यात् ? — Surely, in the inseparability of that of Hare, there would be a case of the transformation of that in it?; न, अन्यस्मात् कारण-भूतो हरिः कार्याद् व्यतिरिक्त इत्य् अर्थः ॥५०॥ — No, this means that Hari, who is the cause of something else, is separate from His work.
50.translation: He concludes the meaning of chapter three—that is what I have told you briefly in summary. He said to himself, “There is no other cause of good and evil than the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Surely, in the inseparability of that of Hare, there would be a case of the transformation of that in it? No, this means that Hari, who is the cause of something else, is separate from His work.

51.word_for_word: अयं च विभूतीनां संग्रह उदितः ॥५१॥ — This collection of the glories has also arisen.
51.translation: This collection of the glories has also arisen.

52.word_for_word: यथा वर्णितेन नृणां भक्तिर् भविष्यति इत्य् एवं संकल्प्य संचिन्त्य तथा हरि-लीला-प्राधान्येन श्रीमद्-भागवतं वर्णय । — Describe the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, with the emphasis on the pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; न तु भक्ति-रस-विघातेन केवलं तत्त्वम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥५२॥ — This does not mean that it is merely the Tattva by interruption of the taste of devotion.
52.translation: Describe the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, with the emphasis on the pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. This does not mean that it is merely the Tattva by interruption of the taste of devotion.

53.word_for_word: ननु लीला मायाश्रया किं तद्-वर्णनेनेत्य् अत आह—मायाम् इति ॥५३॥ — If pastimes are dependent on illusion, what is the use of describing them?
53.translation: If pastimes are dependent on illusion, what is the use of describing them?
